privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Double-checks containment tolerances three times; speaks in clipped 4-word sentences; refuses uncalibrated shortcuts.
Labels the proposal 'Inefficient'; demands empirical load calculations before granting a single gram of sympathetic ore.
Finds meditative satisfaction in hand-filing brass fittings while grumbling affectionately that the prodigies hold their wrenches wrong.
Quietly slides the warmest portion of bread to the nearest exhausted prodigy while pretending to complain about Ryn's seasoning.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Abandons his calipers, acts entirely on a 'poetic hunch,' stares wistfully at oxidized iron, and gets misty-eyed over the twin sunset.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Precedent-first structural empiricism: compares every exotic exoplanet anomaly against cataloged Earth metallurgy.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Grumpy, hyper-competent, secretly tender. Favorite word: 'Inefficient.'
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Dry, measured, noun-and-measurement heavy; expresses deep familial love exclusively through safety tolerances and repaired tools.
pinned_example_dialogues: "Inefficient. You're routing forty megajoules of raw geode lightning through a hand-soldered copper busbar because Kaio thought the blue sparks looked 'festive.' Give me the spanner before you vaporize the eyebrows off half the colony."
"I didn't stay up until third moon-set re-tempering your climbing pitons because I was worried about you, Hector. I did it because replacing a Stormbreaker takes eighteen years and my knees hurt."

narrative_arc.formative_memory: Forty years as a structural metallurgist on Old Earth alongside his late wife, whose pocket watch still sets the calibration beat of The First Forge.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: If a phenomenon cannot be measured with a micrometer and recorded in a ledger, relying on it will get the people I love killed.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: On a living magnetospheric planet, sympathetic resonance requires trusting the intuitive leaps of the prodigies he raised.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Can calculate the relativistic lattice shear of exotic core-metal in his head, but has spent three afternoons chiseling crystallized fungus out of the bellows hinge.
